facts.text: Keep exploring UP while each step still earns reward; switch direction as soon as reward falls to 0, which may signal a wall or obstacle.
When straight UP yields only +0.1 for about 5 steps, try a diagonal or side branch such as UP+LEFT to find new facts, which are worth far more than plain walking.
When a nearby NPC, sign, door or object comes into view, detour to it and press A to trigger new text or facts instead of walking past.
When DOWN returns a stuck penalty (-0.5), do not use DOWN to back out; sidestep with LEFT or RIGHT, or continue on the upward diagonal that was earning reward.
After an UP+diagonal stretch goes flat for about 3 steps, flip the horizontal component (RIGHT+UP <-> LEFT+UP), since changing heading has coincided with new facts.
After a heading change back to straight UP earns a new fact, keep pushing that route into unexplored ground rather than retracing already-covered areas.
If the 'wait' action under a goto directive yields a stuck penalty once, stop waiting and immediately issue a movement or A press; repeated waits only stack -0.5 penalties.
Treat 'goto' as unreliable once it reports stuck with 'wait'; abandon it after one failure and switch to manual 'walk' moves, which earned steady positive reward.
If a goto toward RIGHT returns stuck, switch to walk UP+LEFT, which immediately earned a new fact after that failure.
Do not stay with a stuck goto for the occasional +0.5 fact; alternating learned and stuck turns nets a loss, so change target, direction or action type.
When stuck without movement, press A or B to clear a possible open dialog or menu, then test a short walk in each direction to find the open path.
During dialogue, keep pressing B through at least 6 zero-reward presses, since new text and a fact (+3) arrived after such a gap.
Stop alternating RIGHT and Y once it goes flat for 2 steps; after that pattern, switching to dialogue with B earned +3.
Do not rely on Y to interact, as it earned almost nothing; try A or B on the target instead.
If B in dialogue earns nothing for about 8 straight presses, try A once, then a short walk to check whether the text box has closed or a choice is waiting.
Treat a steady rhythm of new text about every 7 B presses as a live, progressing conversation, and stay in dialogue while that rhythm holds, even though most steps score zero.
In a long conversation, test A for a few presses and keep it only if new text arrives in fewer than the roughly 7 steps B has been taking.
While walk UP+LEFT keeps earning +0.1, keep issuing it and do not switch to goto; six walk steps gained 0.5, then nine stuck goto waits lost 4.5.
If a manual walk reports stuck just after changing direction, try that direction once more before abandoning it; a second walk RIGHT immediately earned a new fact (+1.1).
After about 6 flat +0.1 steps in one walk direction, bend to a diagonal, since switching from RIGHT to UP+RIGHT immediately earned a new fact.
If walking UP ends in a block and both RIGHT and LEFT report stuck, try DOWN+RIGHT next, since it broke free and earned a new fact (+1.1).
Also bend from a diagonal back to a straight direction after about 6 flat steps, since switching from UP+RIGHT to UP immediately earned a new fact (+1.1).
Avoid immediately reversing over ground just walked (DOWN, then UP, then back), since steps 29-40 mostly paced this way and earned only +0.1 each apart from one stuck penalty.
Stop alternating UP and Y in interact mode after 2-3 unrewarded steps; steps 55-60 earned almost nothing, so resume walking, where even flat steps earn +0.1.
After walking into something in a new area, tap toward it once, then use A to inspect; the first UP interaction earned +1.1, but repeating UP afterward earned nothing.
When a walk goes flat or reports stuck, also try a 90-degree turn; switching from DOWN to LEFT immediately earned a new fact (+1.1).
Do not use Y to inspect or advance in interact mode, since every Y press in steps 56-75 earned 0.0; use A for a single check instead.
Treat 4 consecutive 0.0 steps as a hard loop breaker that overrides any rhythm or interact directive: switch to walking LEFT, RIGHT or DOWN to leave the spot.
Change the directive itself from interact to walk when stuck: steps 71-90 repeated UP,Y for 20 steps at 0.0, forfeiting the +0.1 per step that even flat walking earns.
After about 6 flat walk steps, issue a goto toward a new side target, since goto LEFT at step 15 earned +2.1 (two facts), double the best walk steps.
Abandon a goto after 2 consecutive waits with -0.5 stuck; steps 24-29 waited six times for nothing, so switch to a manual walk direction immediately.
When new text appears and the next step reports stuck, assume a dialog box is open and press A to advance it instead of waiting, since steps 17-21 mostly lost -0.5 each after new text.
During a stalled goto, send a side direction instead of wait; LEFT at step 22 and RIGHT at step 30 each earned a new fact (+0.5) despite the stuck penalty.
When a goto approaches an object or character, press the direction straight into it; interact LEFT at step 8 earned +2.5 (new text and a fact) even while reporting stuck.
After an interaction pays out and the next press earns 0.0, walk away the opposite way at once; walking RIGHT at step 12, after three 0.0 steps, earned +2.0.
When interact presses go flat after a paying UP check, try one B press in dialogue mode; B at step 23 earned +2.0 with new text and a fact after three near-zero steps.
Stop pressing B after one 0.0 result and resume walking; steps 24-26 repeated B for nothing, forfeiting the +0.1 per step that flat walking earns.
Keep a goto running while each step still reports new text, even if flagged stuck or waiting; steps 35-37 earned +1.5 each, so apply the abandon-goto rule only once new text stops.
When a goto's new-text payouts shrink and it stays stuck, switch to interact with a direction press; DOWN at step 38 right after the goto earned +3.1.
Prefer a fresh direction or walking over Y during interact; Y at steps 39 and 41 earned only 0.1 and 0.0.
If the first B press scores 0.0 but logs a learned fact, press B exactly once more; step 42 did this and step 43 then earned +3.0.
Start a goto early when walking stays flat; goto at steps 33-34 earned +3.1 each, versus 0.1 per step for walking LEFT at steps 28-32.
In an active conversation, press B through two consecutive 0.0 steps, overriding the one-zero stop rule; steps 43-52 paid +2 to +4 on every third press.
After three consecutive 0.0 B presses, treat the dialogue as finished and walk or goto elsewhere; steps 53-60 spent eight turns on B and earned nothing.
Do not let one late payout restart a B streak; step 64 paid +2.0, then steps 65-75 spent eleven turns on B for nothing.
Before choosing dialogue/B, count recent 0.0 B steps; at three or more, issue a goto to a new target instead, even if the directive still says dialogue.
After three 0.0 B presses, never choose B on the next step: send a direction press or goto; steps 71-90 pressed B twenty times for only one +2.0.
If B keeps scoring 0.0 and the screen may still hold a box or menu, try A once, then a direction, to break out instead of repeating B (untested).
If dialogue/B persists for 20 steps and earns about +3 or less, treat the dialogue flag as stale and goto a new area; steps 86-105 earned only +1.0 at step 94 and +2.0 at step 100.
When a goto is unavailable or the directive stays dialogue after a 20-step B drought, send a different direction each step to move the character; steps 101-119 pressed B nineteen times for 0.0.
Treat any B lesson's exceptions as expired once ten straight steps score 0.0; do not press B again until a movement or goto step earns reward.
If a single DOWN after a long B streak scores 0.0, do not return to B; try LEFT, RIGHT, or UP next to find an exit (untested).
To escape a dead dialogue flag, walk in varied directions until reward returns, then goto; this worked at steps 122-129 (RIGHT first moved for reward at 125-127).
Prefer goto as soon as it is available after breaking free; steps 128-129 learned new facts at +1.1 each, versus +0.1 per walk step.
After three consecutive +0.1 walk steps in one direction, goto an unexplored person, object, or exit; steps 131-135 drifted LEFT for only +0.5 total.
When a step is marked stuck with negative reward, change direction or route around the obstacle; steps 123-124 lost 0.5 each.
Apply the three-step +0.1 limit to goto as well: pick a different target if no new reward arrives; steps 148-150 moved DOWN for only +0.3.
When a walk direction stalls, turn perpendicular early; switching LEFT to UP at step 137 immediately learned a new fact for +1.1.
Override the three-step limit for an advancing goto: allow about 7 steps of +0.1 travel, since steps 152-158 and 159-165 each ended in +3.1.
Keep the current goto after a single stuck step if the route then resumes; steps 147 and 154 each preceded a +3.1 within 4 steps.
Prioritize goto targets likely to show new text (unvisited people, signs, objects); steps 151, 158 and 165 earned +3.1 each, far above plain walking.
Keep exploring up and right in the current area while it yields new text; RIGHT/UP gotos produced all three +3.1 rewards in steps 146-165 (untested elsewhere).
Leave interact after the first 0.0 step and goto; steps 168-170 alternated Y and UP for nothing, then goto at 171 earned +2.0.
After a new-text reward, continue the goto once more before interacting; steps 165-166 earned +3.1 back to back.
While interacting beside a target, try each facing direction before leaving, even after one 0.0 step; at step 188 turning UP earned +2.0 after four weak steps (184-187).
After finishing an interaction, walk toward an unvisited exit; walking DOWN at step 191 found a new area for +1.5.
If the same direction sticks twice within three steps, abandon it and goto a visible exit or object; RIGHT lost 0.5 at both steps 192 and 194.
Default to goto over walk for exploring: walk steps 192-197 and 199-204 each netted -1.2, while gotos at 198 and 205 earned +1.1 and +2.5.
Keep advancing while each step shows new text, even if flagged stuck; goto/wait steps 217-219 earned +1.5 each.
After new text stops and two steps lose 0.5, stop waiting; steps 220-221 yielded nothing further.
If movement stays stuck after dialogue, try A or B to clear a possible open box before moving (untested); DOWN failed at steps 222-224.
Press START when dialogue stops yielding and see whether it opens new text; step 232 earned +3.0 after two silent B presses.
After one rewarding B press in dialogue, stop B after two 0.0 steps; steps 230-231 and 233-235 earned nothing.
When stuck going DOWN or at a failed interact, walk RIGHT to probe a new route; step 236 earned +2.0.
After a walk reward, change direction at the first stuck step; repeating RIGHT at steps 237-238 only lost reward.
Avoid repeating freeform B+LEFT+UP holds; steps 243-248 netted about -0.2, while switching to goto at 249-250 earned +2.1.
Retarget goto to a different exit or object once gains fall to 0.1; steps 251-253 barely paid and 254-255 stuck on RIGHT.
When stuck gotos are followed by a failed interact, face a new direction and press Y, then advance with B; steps 257-260 led to +6.0 across 260-266.
In a freshly opened dialogue, keep pressing B through up to two 0.0 steps while text remains unfinished; rewards recurred every third press at steps 260, 263 and 266.
In long cutscene-style dialogue, allow up to five 0.0 B presses before quitting; step 272 paid +2.0 after five silent ones (267-271).
If goto RIGHT and then walk LEFT both give no movement right after dialogue (steps 282-285), assume text is still open and resume B or B+START before moving again.
When a goto returns no-feedback with 0.0 just after dialogue, do not repeat it; steps 283-284 repeated RIGHT and lost 0.5 each.
